## 7. SET COLORS AND THRESHOLDS
```{r Colors}
colors <- c("H"="blue", "IM"="hotpink", "UM"="black", "UT"="lightgreen", "IT"="purple")
pad <- 0.05
lfc_thresh <- 1.0
```

## 8. RUN DESeq
```{r DESeq-run, message=FALSE}
  ######################### RUN DESEQ  ######################### 
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = ImvHvUM,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ Groups)

## Prefilter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]
## UM reference
dds$Groups <- relevel(dds$Groups, ref = "UM")
cat("📊 Counts loaded:", nrow(dds), "genes x", ncol(dds), "samples\n")

## Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds)

## Save full DESeq object
#saveRDS(dds, file.path(procdata_dir, "dds_IM_H_UM.rds"))
sf <- round(sizeFactors(dds), 3)
kable(data.frame(Sample=names(sf), SizeFactor=sf), caption="Size Factors")
```


## 9. DESEQ Result Comparisons
```{r DESeq-results-summary}
  ######################### RESULTS   ######################### 
res_IM_UM <- results(dds, name = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", alpha = 0.05)
res_H_UM  <- results(dds, name = "Groups_H_vs_UM", alpha = 0.05)

# Define your comparisons in a list
comparisons <- list(
  "IM vs UM" = res_IM_UM,
  "H vs UM"  = res_H_UM
)
cat("Differentially Expressed Genes (padj < 0.05):\n", separator, "\n")

for (cmp_name in names(comparisons)) {
  res <- comparisons[[cmp_name]]
  
  total <- sum(res$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  up    <- sum(res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  down  <- sum(res$padj < 0.05 & res$log2FoldChange < 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("%-10s: Total = %4d | Up = %4d | Down = %4d\n",
              cmp_name, total, up, down))
}
```

## 14. LFC SHRINKAGE + ARRANGEMENT + CLEAN
```{r DESeq-results-lfc, message=FALSE}
#########################  DESeq2 LFC Shrinkage & Cleaning  #########################
# function to safely run lfcShrink with fallback
safe_lfcShrink <- function(dds, coef_name, contrast_vec) {
  tryCatch({
    lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef_name, type = "apeglm")
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste0("apeglm failed for ", coef_name, ", using normal: ", e$message))
    lfcShrink(dds, contrast = contrast_vec, type = "normal")
  })
}

######################### CONTRASTS #########################
contrasts <- list(
  H_vs_UM  = list(coef = "Groups_H_vs_UM",  contrast = c("Groups", "H", "UM")),
  IM_vs_UM = list(coef = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", contrast = c("Groups", "IM", "UM"))
)

######################### RUN SHRINKAGE #########################
lfc_list <- lapply(contrasts, function(x) {
  safe_lfcShrink(dds, x$coef, x$contrast)
})

######################### CLEAN RESULTS #########################
clean_res <- function(lfc_obj) {
  as.data.frame(lfc_obj) %>%
    rownames_to_column("TAIR") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    arrange(padj)
}

res_list <- lapply(lfc_list, clean_res)

#########################  Split DEGs #########################  
annotate_DEGs <- function(df, lfc_thresh, pad) {
  df %>%
   mutate(
      DEG = padj < pad & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh,
      direction = case_when(
        DEG & log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh  ~ "UP",
        DEG & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh ~ "DOWN",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
}
res_list <- lapply(res_list, annotate_DEGs, lfc_thresh, pad)

#########################  ADD ANNOTATION #########################
add_annotations <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      symbol = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "SYMBOL",
                      keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first"),
      entrez = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "ENTREZID",
                      keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first")
    )
}

res_list <- lapply(res_list, add_annotations)
#########################  EXTRACT DEG SUBSETS #########################
deg_list <- lapply(res_list, function(df) df %>% filter(DEG))
deg_split <- lapply(deg_list, function(df) split(df, df$direction))

#########################  SUMMARY TABLE #########################
summary_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(res_list), function(name) {
  df <- res_list[[name]]
  tibble(
    contrast = name,
    n_DEG  = sum(df$DEG),
    up     = sum(df$direction == "UP"),
    down   = sum(df$direction == "DOWN")
  )
}))

summary_tbl

#########################  MA PLOTS #########################
plot_DEGs_MA <- function(lfc_obj, df, title) {
  plotMA(lfc_obj, ylim = c(-5,5), main = title)
  
  sig <- df$DEG
  
  points(
    log2(lfc_obj$baseMean[sig] + 1),
    lfc_obj$log2FoldChange[sig],
    col = "red",
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.6
  )
  
  invisible(NULL)
}

purrr::pwalk(
  list(lfc_list, res_list, names(res_list)),
  plot_DEGs_MA
)

#########################  EXPORT #########################
export_list <- c(
  res_list,
  setNames(deg_list, paste0(names(deg_list), "_DEGs"))
)

writexl::write_xlsx(export_list, file.path(tables_dir, "DESeq2_results_shrink.xlsx"))
```

## 15. TOP 100 GENES & HEATMAP
```{r deg-heatmap}
set.seed(123)
######################### TOP 100 DEGs HEATMAP #########################
topN <- 100  # Number of genes to display

# Get top N DEGs for each contrast ranked by |LFC|
top_DE_IM <- deg_list$IM_vs_UM %>%
  filter(DEG) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(TAIR)

top_DE_H <- deg_list$H_vs_UM %>%
  filter(DEG) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(TAIR)

# Option 1: intersection (shared DEGs)
top_DE_genes <- intersect(top_DE_IM, top_DE_H)

# union of top N
# top_DE_genes <- union(top_DE_IM, top_DE_H)

cat("Top DE genes (padj<", pad, ", |LFC|≥", lfc_thresh, "):", length(top_DE_genes), "\n")

# Keep only genes present in normalized counts
top_DE_genes <- intersect(top_DE_genes, rownames(norm_counts))

if(length(top_DE_genes) > 0){

  # Subset normalized counts
  deg_mat <- norm_counts[top_DE_genes, ]

  # Create row annotation for direction
  direction_df <- deg_list$IM_vs_UM %>%
    filter(TAIR %in% top_DE_genes) %>%
    select(TAIR, direction) %>%
    column_to_rownames("TAIR")
  
  # Sample annotation
  ann_col <- data.frame(Groups = sample_info$Groups)
  rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(deg_mat)

  # Define colors for annotations
  ann_colors <- list(
    Groups = c(IM = "hotpink", H = "blue", UM = "black"),
    direction = c(UP = "#e41a1c", DOWN = "#377eb8")
  )

  # Generate heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    deg_mat,
    scale = "row",  # Z-score per gene
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdYlBu")))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
    clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
    clustering_method = "complete",
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_row = direction_df,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_rownames = ifelse(length(top_DE_genes) < 30, TRUE, FALSE),
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    main = paste0("Top ", length(top_DE_genes), 
                  " DE Genes (Top ", topN, " by |LFC| per contrast)"),
    fontsize_row = 8,
    filename = file.path(graphics_dir, "heatmap_top_DE_genes_direction.png"),
    width = 12, height = 10
  )

  # Optional export
  top_DE_df <- data.frame(Gene = top_DE_genes)
  # write.csv(top_DE_df, file.path(tables_dir, "top_DE_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  # writexl::write_xlsx(top_DE_df, file.path(tables_dir, "top_DE_genes.xlsx"))

} else {
  cat("No DE genes found in norm_counts.\n")
}
```


```{r H v UM DEGS}
######################### Shared DEGs #########################
# Extract DEG tables
deg_H <- deg_list$H_vs_UM
deg_IM <- deg_list$IM_vs_UM

# Identify shared and unique genes
shared_genes <- intersect(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)
unique_H <- setdiff(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)
unique_IM <- setdiff(deg_IM$TAIR, deg_H$TAIR)

# Shared DEGs with average LFC
deg_shared <- deg_H %>%
  filter(TAIR %in% shared_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    deg_IM %>% select(TAIR, log2FoldChange_IM = log2FoldChange, padj_IM = padj),
    by = "TAIR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(avg_lfc = (log2FoldChange + coalesce(log2FoldChange_IM, 0)) / 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_lfc)))
# Summary table: counts per contrast and shared/unique
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  Category = c("H_vs_UM", "IM_vs_UM", "Shared", "Unique_H", "Unique_IM"),
  n_genes  = c(nrow(deg_H), nrow(deg_IM), length(shared_genes), length(unique_H), length(unique_IM))
)

# Optional: percentages of H/IM genes for shared/unique
summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    percent_of_H  = round(100 * n_genes / nrow(deg_H), 1),
    percent_of_IM = round(100 * n_genes / nrow(deg_IM), 1)
  )

# Excel export: all key DEG tables
deg_workbook <- list(
  H_vs_UM     = deg_H %>% arrange(padj),
  IM_vs_UM    = deg_IM %>% arrange(padj),
  Shared_DEGs = deg_shared,
  Unique_H    = deg_H %>% filter(TAIR %in% unique_H),
  Unique_IM   = deg_IM %>% filter(TAIR %in% unique_IM)
)

# Uncomment to export
# writexl::write_xlsx(deg_workbook, file.path(tables_dir, "DEG_summary.xlsx"))

# Print summary
summary_tbl
```

```{r}
#########################  PREPARE ENTREZ LISTS #########################
# Flatten DEG splits into clean Entrez ID lists
entrez_list <- lapply(deg_split, function(contrast_list) {
  list(
    UP   = unique(contrast_list$UP$entrez[!is.na(contrast_list$UP$entrez)]),
    DOWN = unique(contrast_list$DOWN$entrez[!is.na(contrast_list$DOWN$entrez)])
  )
})

# Flatten for 4-way comparison
entrez_flat <- list(
  IM_UP   = entrez_list$IM_vs_UM$UP,
  H_UP    = entrez_list$H_vs_UM$UP,
  IM_DOWN = entrez_list$IM_vs_UM$DOWN,
  H_DOWN  = entrez_list$H_vs_UM$DOWN
)

#########################  GO BP ENRICHMENT #########################
ego_list <- lapply(names(entrez_flat), function(category){
  genes <- entrez_flat[[category]]
  if(length(genes) >= 10){
    enrichGO(
      gene = genes,
      OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
      keyType = "ENTREZID",
      ont = "BP",
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff = pad,
      qvalueCutoff = pad,
      minGSSize = 10,
      maxGSSize = 500
    )
  } else NULL
})
names(ego_list) <- names(entrez_flat)

# Assign backward-compatible objects
ego_IMup   <- ego_list$IM_UP
ego_Hup    <- ego_list$H_UP
ego_IMdown <- ego_list$IM_DOWN
ego_Hdown  <- ego_list$H_DOWN

#########################  GO DOTPLOT #########################
go_compare <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = entrez_flat,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = pad,
  qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

p_go_dot <- dotplot(go_compare, showCategory = 10, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) +
  ggtitle("GO BP Terms: 4-way Comparison (IM_UP/H_UP/IM_DOWN/H_DOWN)")
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GO_BP_4way_combined_dotplot.png"), 
       plot = p_go_dot, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved GO BP 4-way combined dotplot\n")

go_export <- c(
  # GO
  lapply(ego_list, function(x) if(!is.null(x)) x@result else data.frame())
)

writexl::write_xlsx(go_export, file.path(tables_dir, "COMPLETE_GO.xlsx"))
cat("GO results exported successfully\n")

#########################  KEGG ENRICHMENT #########################
kegg_list <- entrez_flat

kegg_results <- lapply(names(kegg_list), function(category){
  genes <- kegg_list[[category]]
  if(length(genes) >= 10){
    enrichKEGG(
      gene = genes,
      organism = "ath",
      keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
      pvalueCutoff = pad,
      qvalueCutoff = pad,
      minGSSize = 10,
      maxGSSize = 500,
      use_internal_data = FALSE
    )
  } else NULL
})
names(kegg_results) <- names(kegg_list)

# KEGG 4-way compareCluster
kegg_compare <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = kegg_list,
  fun = "enrichKEGG",
  organism = "ath",
  keyType = "ncbi-geneid",
  pvalueCutoff = pad,
  qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  use_internal_data = FALSE
)

p_kegg_dot <- dotplot(kegg_compare, showCategory = 10, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) +
  ggtitle("KEGG Pathways: 4-way Comparison (IM_UP/H_UP/IM_DOWN/H_DOWN)")
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "KEGG_4way_combined_dotplot.png"), 
       plot = p_kegg_dot, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved KEGG 4-way combined dotplot\n")

#########################  SUMMARY TABLE #########################
go_kegg_summary <- tibble(
  Category = names(entrez_flat),
  n_genes = sapply(entrez_flat, length),
  n_GO_terms = sapply(ego_list, function(x) if(!is.null(x)) nrow(x@result) else 0),
  n_KEGG_terms = sapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(!is.null(x)) nrow(x@result) else 0)
)
print(go_kegg_summary)

#########################  EXPORT RESULTS #########################
full_export <- c(
  
  # KEGG individual
  lapply(kegg_results, function(x) if(!is.null(x)) x@result else data.frame()),
  
  # KEGG combined
  list(KEGG_4way_compare = as.data.frame(kegg_compare@compareClusterResult)),
  
  # Summary
  list(Summary = go_kegg_summary)
)

writexl::write_xlsx(full_export, file.path(tables_dir, "COMPLETE_KEGG_4way.xlsx"))
cat("KEGG results exported successfully\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Categorize DEGs based on significance and LFC
FW_df$plot$data <- FW_df$plot$data %>%
  mutate(
    DE_status = case_when(
      padj_x < pad & abs(logFC_x) > lfc_thresh &
      padj_y < pad & abs(logFC_y) > lfc_thresh ~ "H+IM",
      
      padj_x < pad & abs(logFC_x) > lfc_thresh &
      (padj_y >= pad | abs(logFC_y) <= lfc_thresh) ~ "H_only",
      
      padj_x >= pad & padj_y >= pad ~ "NS",
      
      padj_y < pad & abs(logFC_y) > lfc_thresh &
      (padj_x >= pad | abs(logFC_x) <= lfc_thresh) ~ "IM_only"
    ),
    # Scale point size based on combined magnitude of LFCs
    LFC_magnitude = sqrt(logFC_x^2 + logFC_y^2)
  )

# Assign colors
intersection_colors <- c(
  "H+IM" = "purple",
  "H_only" = "blue",
  "NS" = "gray60",
  "IM_only" = "hotpink"
)

# Update plot with color and size aesthetics
FW_plot_intersect <- ggplot(FW_df$plot$data, aes(x = logFC_x, y = logFC_y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = DE_status, size = LFC_magnitude), alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = intersection_colors) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5)) + # adjust min/max size
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "log2FC H vs UM",
    y = "log2FC IM vs UM",
    color = "DE Category",
    size = "Combined LFC"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Four-Way DE Intersection with LFC Magnitude")

print(FW_plot_intersect)

# Optional save
ggsave(
  file.path(graphics_dir, "FourWay_H_vs_IM_vs_UM_intersection_LFCsize.png"),
  plot = FW_plot_intersect, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.At.tair.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#----------------------------
# 1. Convert enrichGO → data.frame + add labels
#----------------------------

process_GO <- function(ego, label) {
  if (is.null(ego)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)  # handles H_up case
  
  df$Group <- label
  return(df)
}

H_up_df   <- process_GO(ego_H_up, "H Up")
H_down_df <- process_GO(ego_H_down, "H Down")
IM_up_df  <- process_GO(ego_IM_up, "IM Up")
IM_down_df<- process_GO(ego_IM_down, "IM Down")

#----------------------------
# 2. Combine safely
#----------------------------

combined_GO <- bind_rows(
  H_up_df,
  H_down_df,
  IM_up_df,
  IM_down_df
)

#----------------------------
# 3. Select top terms per group
#----------------------------

top_GO <- combined_GO %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

#----------------------------
# 4. Plot
#----------------------------

ggplot(top_GO, aes(x = Group, y = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  facet_wrap(~Group, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "GO Molecular Function Enrichment",
    x = "",
    y = "GO Terms",
    size = "Gene Count",
    color = "-log10(adj p-value)"
  )
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "GO_MF.png"), 
       width = 20, 
       height = 10, 
       dpi = 300)

```





```{r}
library(dplyr)

extract_top_terms <- function(ego_obj, group_name, top_n = 8) {
  df <- ego_obj@result
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = group_name,
      GeneRatio_num = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) eval(parse(text = x)))
    )
}

H_up_df    <- extract_top_terms(ego_H_up, "Haustoria Up")
H_down_df  <- extract_top_terms(ego_H_down, "Haustoria Down")
IM_up_df   <- extract_top_terms(ego_IM_up, "Mesophyll Up")
IM_down_df <- extract_top_terms(ego_IM_down, "Mesophyll Down")
go_combined <- bind_rows(H_down_df, H_up_df, IM_down_df, IM_up_df)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(go_combined, aes(x = reorder(Description, GeneRatio_num), 
                        y = GeneRatio_num, 
                        fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Group, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "GO Term Trends Across Conditions (Exploratory)",
    subtitle = "No terms passed BH-adjusted significance threshold (p.adjust < 0.05)",
    x = "GO Term",
    y = "Gene Ratio"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "combined_GO_terms_BP.png"),
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# ===============================================
# Transporter Family Summary and Bubble Barplot
# ===============================================

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)

# -----------------------------
# Summarize family-level stats
# -----------------------------

# Ensure one row per gene
family_summary <- H_up_transporters %>%
  distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%   # avoid duplicates
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_count = n(),
    median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
    median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(gene_count))

# Optional: filter out very small families (e.g., 1 gene)
# family_summary <- family_summary %>% filter(gene_count >= 2)

# -----------------------------
# Plot bubble barplot
# -----------------------------

fam_plot <- ggplot(family_summary,
                   aes(x = fct_reorder(Family, gene_count),
                       y = gene_count)) +
  
  # Bars = number of genes per family
  geom_col(fill = "grey85") +
  
  # Overlay bubbles = expression + significance
  geom_point(aes(size = median_log10_padj,
                 color = median_logFC)) +
  
  # Flip axes for readability
  coord_flip() +
  
  # Color gradient: blue = down, white = neutral, red = up
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#4575b4",   # lower induction
    mid = "white",
    high = "hotpink",  # stronger induction
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Transporter Family-Level Response in Haustoriated Cells",
    x = "Transporter Family",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    color = "Median log2FC",
    size = "Median -log10(padj)"
  ) +
  
  # Theme adjustments
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Display plot
print(fam_plot)

# -----------------------------
# Save the plot
# -----------------------------
```

```{r}
summarize_families <- function(df, direction){
  df %>%
    distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%
    mutate(Direction = direction) %>%
    group_by(Family, Direction) %>%
    summarise(
      gene_count = n(),
      median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
      median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

H_up_summary <- summarize_families(H_up_transporters, "Up")
H_down_summary <- summarize_families(H_down_transporters, "Down")
combined_summary <- bind_rows(H_up_summary, H_down_summary)
combined_summary$Direction <- factor(combined_summary$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))

family_order <- combined_summary %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(total_genes = sum(gene_count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_genes)) %>%
  pull(Family)



combined_summary$Family <- factor(combined_summary$Family, levels = family_order)
ggplot(combined_summary,
       aes(x = gene_count, y = Family)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(size = median_log10_padj, color = median_logFC)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "purple", mid = "white", high = "hotpink", midpoint = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~Direction, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), limits = c(0,10)) +  # set ticks from 0-10 by 2
  labs(
    title = "Transporter Family-Level Response in Haustoriated Cells",
    x = "Number of Genes",
    y = "Transporter Family",
    color = "Median log2FC",
    size = "Median -log10(padj)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "H_combined_families.png"),
      width = 10,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
##############################
# TRANSPORTER FAMILY PLOT
##############################

# Load packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Load transporter gene data
# -----------------------------
transporter_genes <- read_excel("../HvIM/Data_Repository/6_transporter_df.xlsx") %>%
  rename(id = TAIR) %>%
  mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id)))

# Assuming your H_up/H_down tables already exist
green_H_up <- green_H_up %>% mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id)))
green_H_down <- green_H_down %>% mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id)))

# -----------------------------
# 2. Extract transporters
# -----------------------------
H_up_transporters <- green_H_up %>%
  semi_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  select(id, logFC_x, padj_x, Family) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC_x)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    log10_padj = -log10(padj_x),
    FC_label = round(logFC_x, 2)
  )

H_down_transporters <- green_H_down %>%
  semi_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  select(id, logFC_x, padj_x, Family) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC_x)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    log10_padj = -log10(padj_x),
    FC_label = round(logFC_x, 2)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3. Assign functional categories
# -----------------------------
family_function <- data.frame(
  Family = c(
    "ABC Superfamily", "DMT Superfamily", "MOP Flippase Superfamily",
    "CPA2 Family", "MIP Family", "VIT Family", "MPT Family",
    "MFS", "ENT Family", "AAAP Family", "ZIP Family", "P-ATPase Superfamily",
    "OPT Family", "MC Family", "KUP Family", "HCC Family",
    "FBT Family", "CDF Family", "ArAE Family", "Annexin Family", "AE Family"
  ),
  Function = c(
    rep("Detox/Drug Export", 3),   # 3
    rep("Ion Transport", 3),       # 3 → total 6
    "Metabolite Transport",        # 1 → total 7
    rep("Nutrient Transport", 8),  # 8 → total 15
    rep("Other/Unknown", 6)        # 6 → total 21
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Combine up and down transporters
# -----------------------------
H_up_summary <- H_up_transporters %>%
  distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "Up") %>%
  group_by(Family, Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_count = n(),
    median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
    median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

H_down_summary <- H_down_transporters %>%
  distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "Down") %>%
  group_by(Family, Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_count = n(),
    median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
    median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

combined_summary <- bind_rows(H_up_summary, H_down_summary) %>%
  left_join(family_function, by = "Family") %>%
  mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down")))

# -----------------------------
# 5. Plot transporter families
# -----------------------------
fam_plot <- ggplot(combined_summary,
                   aes(x = gene_count,
                       y = fct_reorder(Family, gene_count))) +
  
  # Bars = number of genes
  geom_col(aes(fill = Function), color = "grey50") +
  
  # Overlay points = median logFC significance
  geom_point(aes(size = median_log10_padj, color = median_logFC)) +
  
  # Facet Up vs Down
  facet_wrap(~Direction, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  
  # Color scale for logFC
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "purple", mid = "white", high = "hotpink", midpoint = 0) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Transporter Family-Level Response in Haustoriated Cells",
    x = "Number of Genes",
    y = "Transporter Family",
    fill = "Functional Category",
    color = "Median log2FC",
    size = "Median -log10(padj)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Display plot
print(fam_plot)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Save outputs
# -----------------------------
graphics_dir <- "../HvIM/Graphics"
tables_dir <- "../HvIM/Tables"

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "H_combined_families_function.png"),
       fam_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

write.csv(combined_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "H_combined_families_function.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write_xlsx(combined_summary, file.path(tables_dir, "H_combined_families_function.xlsx"))
```
